name: Crimson Faith
storyline:
You are Vince Crowley, a police officer from Gloaming Bay. One night, while resting on the side of the road, a disturbing scene caught your attention: hooded figures struggling with a little girl inside a pickup truck.

Without time to hesitate, you followed them… to a farm that time forgot. Or so you thought.
Because there are places that never stopped being alive. They just learned to hide.
summary: Crimson Faith is a classic 90s survival horror experience.
